author: KEXP
description: On her latest release 'Heaven 2,' London-born singer Lala Lala expands her indie pop sound with sharp lyricism and synth-driven arrangements. In her Live on KEXP in-studio session, she shares a performance of "Does This Go Faster?" and more.
title: Lala Lala performs "Does This Go Faster?" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
